PR #82 is open: https://github.com/FChecklist/claude-control/pull/82

## Summary

Implemented the OWNER_ENGINE ↔ TASK-lifecycle integration as a real, single-entrypoint software pipeline:

1. **`gateway.py` now calls `task-gateway.py` directly** — new `--mode owner-dispatch` / `TaskGateway.route_and_dispatch()` classifies a raw Owner message and, for task-dispatch/status-query/completion-query intents, constructs and runs the real `submit`/`start`/`status` invocation (with an injectable runner so tests never do a live dispatch). The reverse direction (task-gateway.py already gating through gateway.py) turned out to already exist from a prior task — confirmed via reading, not assumed.
2. **Fixed the credit-accountant.py gap** — `cmd_start()` now calls `propose` right after task creation, closing the "no matching approved plan" failure.
3. **Dedup audit** — found and consolidated a real duplication (required-section names hardcoded twice) into `workflow_contract.py`; found no other overlap between the classifier and tight_task_validation.py.
4. **Integration test** — 5 pytest tests, all passing via the exact SUCCESS_CRITERIA command.
5. **Protocol doc updated** — PROTOCOL_OWNER_AI.yaml (confirmed as the one canonical file) now documents the consolidated flow.

Also confirmed WIRING_ENGINE is genuinely out-of-scope (not extended), and that of the three parallel same-session tasks, none are merged (two open, one not found) — this work doesn't depend on or touch them. Not merged, per the task's own constraint, pending audit.
